Name: Wild Boar Farm
Author: starmops
Description:
What this mod does

This mod will replace the Wilderness Farm Map with a new cliffside farm with pockets of farming space, separated by a deep river from the wilderness beyond. This map was made for players who are into the adventurer/fantasy elements of the game, or who are looking for a challenge.

This mod also replaces the Farm Cave map to add a secret river cave under the cliff! The cave is accessible via the trapdoor (or, in the vanilla version, the suspicious-looking pillar) on the second level. Use it for extra storage, or to hide from ghosts. Don't worry about the mysterious fog going on, it's probably fine.

Features

- All grass tiles are diggable/farmable
- Access the secret tunnel by walking over the trapdoor on the left side of the second level clearing between the farmhouse and greenhouse
- All other aspects of the wilderness farm are preserved

Recolor Notes

I've made separate versions of this map which are compatible with the Vibrant Pastoral Recolor and DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour mods, along with a vanilla version. Download the one that you like best! If you want to use any other recolors, download the vanilla version which should be compatible.

Compatibility

This mod won't be compatible with any other mod that replaces the Wilderness Farm map OR the Farm Cave map.
